verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure that does not bind agents to one model vendor. Its docs list first-party integrations with Gemini Computer Use, Claude Computer Use, and OpenAI Computer Use, plus model-flexible frameworks such as Pydantic AI (explicitly described as provider-agnostic), Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI and Browser-Use, so developers can bring their own LLM provider. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of model-agnosticism or a guide to plugging in arbitrary or self-hosted LLM providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use.
